reason: While Constants.GRANT_TYPE aliases OAuth2Constants.GRANT_TYPE (Constants.java:206-207), the usage is consistent rather than inconsistent: OAuth2GrantType.Context reads the OAuth2 HTTP form parameter via formParams.getFirst(OAuth2Constants.GRANT_TYPE) (OAuth2GrantType.java:102), whereas every ClientSessionContext write (e.g., TokenManager.java:248, OAuth2GrantTypeBase.java:109) and its reader (DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider.java:57) consistently use Constants.GRANT_TYPE per its documented role as a ClientSessionContext note key.
